title: Native Algorithm Rest Adapter
description: Add nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts in semio/algorithms calling REST for python/go/rust and @semio/js for ts; wire Storybook language decorator and engine FastAPI routes end-to-end.
summary: Fixed non-TS languages in algorithms Storybook by keeping /api proxy in semio/algorithms and adding a Storybook-only Vite plugin that auto-starts the engine REST server (uvicorn) on 127.0.0.1:2507 via `start_engine()` (no Qt/PySide6), removing ECONNREFUSED for /api/native-algorithms/execute.
